Name: Marry Morris replacer
Author: LynnNexus
Description:
This is a quick replacer for Marry Morris.  Since I hate the way Morris looks.

To use this:
Unzip.  Inside there are 2 folders
Drop the folders in with the correct mod folder, (Marry Morris with Marry Morris, SVE with SVE)
Allow it to replace files.

Lemme know if you have any issues!

Downloads.Description: Just adding in Morris Redeemed files.  Delete any files you don't need after you unzip.
